tasks.description: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page. This button should initiate a download of the currently displayed report when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the 'Export to CSV' button is clicked, then a CSV download is initiated.

tasks.description: Create a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This should handle large reports efficiently without buffering the entire file in memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without significant memory usage.

tasks.description: Allow the user to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page with column selection, when the user selects specific columns and initiates the export, then the generated CSV includes only the selected columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, when the CSV is generated, then the fields are correctly quoted and escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: The first row of the CSV should contain the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row includes the human-readable column names for the selected columns.

tasks.description: Integrate the export button, streaming export endpoint, column selection, RFC 4180 escaping, and header row functionality to ensure a seamless user experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page with all export features implemented, when the user initiates the export, then the CSV is correctly generated and downloaded, including all selected columns, properly escaped, and with a header row.
